chunks.text: Fields Before Noon. 84 BPM, 4/4, D major. A lute plays a steady flowing arpeggio over soft sustained strings; a wooden flute enters with a simple pastoral melody. Peaceful village morning.
Same tempo and key. The flute repeats the melody with a small variation and a higher ending; a light hand drum and tambourine join quietly; small bells answer the flute.
Same tempo and key. Contrasting middle part: the strings rise warmly to G major and B minor, the flute sings longer notes, the lute keeps its arpeggio, the hand drum stays light.
Same tempo and key. Return of the first flute melody over lute, strings, bells and light hand drum, steady and full, no ending and no slowing down: the music keeps going at the same level.
